salesCopy.secondaryTagline: Quality IT resources I vetted so you don't have to.
salesCopy.problem: The Internet has no shortage of IT tutorials and articles. Finding the good stuff is the hard part. For every well-written explanation, there are dozens of outdated tutorials, shallow blog posts, and content that just gets things wrong.
problemPoints: Most IT content online is mediocre at best
Outdated tutorials still rank high in search results
Hard to know what's actually worth your time
You end up going down rabbit holes that lead nowhere
salesCopy.agitate: When I started writing my Dev Concepts book series, I had to do serious research. I read hundreds of articles, tutorials, and documentation pages. For every one I kept, I threw out five. That curation work took months.
agitatePoints: Proper curation eats up hours you don't have
Without a filter, you miss the gems buried under the noise
salesCopy.solution: The IT Concepts Wall is the research I did for my [Dev Concepts](/product/dev-concepts-starter-bundle) books, organized into a `Trello` board. **200+** resources that passed my quality filters. I rejected most of what I found; what's left is worth reading.
solutionPoints: Organized by topic for easy browsing
Most content I reviewed didn't make the cut
Updated when I find something worth adding
